name: Teakamamire no Tenshi
source:
"An idol who is shining in the spotlight of the stage──"

A girl who try her best maintaining her popularity as an idol by become a "pillow idol". The game also introducing a system called "sub audio system", where player will also able to listen to heroine's inner voice.
translation:
“在舞台聚光灯下闪耀的偶像——”

为了维持偶像人气，女孩努力成为“枕营业偶像”。游戏还引入了“副音频系统”，玩家可以听到女主角的内心独白。
